title: Bumped Rehearsal Slots
description:
## Task

A theatre has booked many rehearsals into one stage, and some clash. Each booking is a half-open range `[start, end)`, so a rehearsal that begins exactly when another ends is fine. Return the fewest bookings that must be bumped so that no two remaining bookings overlap.

## Input

- `slots` — a list of `[start, end]` pairs with `start < end`, in any order. It may be empty.

## Output

The minimum number of bookings to remove (an integer).

## Example

```python
bumped_rehearsals([[1, 4], [2, 6], [5, 8], [8, 9]])  # returns 1
bumped_rehearsals([[0, 5], [5, 10]])  # returns 0
bumped_rehearsals([[1, 10], [2, 3], [4, 5], [6, 7]])  # returns 1
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ number of slots ≤ 10^5
- 0 ≤ `start` < `end` ≤ 10^9
- Identical bookings count separately.
